name: ahard_24_record_query
prompt:
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple


def run_query(records: List[List[Tuple[str, int]]], query: str) -> Optional[List[int]]:
    """ Run a tiny query over records and return the 0-based indices of the
    selected records, in result order.
    Each record is a list of (field, value) pairs; if a field appears more
    than once in a record, its first value counts. The query is a sequence
    of tokens separated by whitespace (leading and trailing whitespace is
    allowed). Its grammar, where every part is optional but the parts must
    come in this order:
        [COND {"and" COND}] ["order" "by" FIELD ["desc"]] ["limit" N]
    COND is exactly three tokens FIELD OP INT, where OP is one of
    = != < <= > >=. FIELD is one or more of the characters a-z and _, and is
    not one of the keywords and, order, by, desc, limit. INT is an optional
    "-" followed by 1 to 9 digits; N is 1 to 9 digits with no sign.
    A record is selected if it satisfies every COND; a COND on a field the
    record does not have is false, for every OP including !=. With no COND,
    every record is selected. "order by FIELD" sorts the selected records
    by that field ascending ("desc": descending); records lacking the field
    come after all records that have it; records with equal values, and
    records lacking the field, keep their original relative order. Without
    "order by", the original order is kept. "limit N" keeps the first N.
    If the query does not match the grammar, return None.
    >>> run_query([[('age', 30)], [('age', 20)], [('id', 1)]], 'age >= 20 order by age')
    [1, 0]
    >>> run_query([[('a', 1)], [('a', 2), ('a', 9)], [('a', 3)]], 'order by a desc limit 2')
    [2, 1]
    """
tests:
def check(candidate):
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'age >= 20 and score > 5') == [0, 1, 3]
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], '') == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'order by age') == [1, 4, 0, 3, 2]
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], '  order   by age desc limit 3 ') == [3, 0, 1]
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'score != 7') == [1, 2]
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'age = 10') == []
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'limit 0') == []
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'score <= 7 and age > -100 order by score desc') == [0, 3]
    assert candidate([], 'limit 5') == []
    assert candidate([[]], '') == [0]
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'age >=20') == None
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'limit 2 order by age') == None
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'age = 1 and') == None
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'desc = 3') == None
    assert candidate([[('age', 30), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20), ('score', 9)], [('score', 5)], [('age', 40), ('age', 10), ('score', 7)], [('age', 20)]], 'age = 1234567890') == None

def test_check():
    check(run_query)
